$comment: Shared cross-language scoring-vector fixtures for cross-provider routing (ROADMAP item 1). Each case pins (candidates + window intensity + weights + batch eligibility) -> the full scored candidate list, the chosen provider:model, and the honest reasoning line. Both the TS suite (test/routing.test.ts) and the Python suite (tests/test_routing.py) load THIS file, run their own scoreCandidates / score_candidates with rng=()=>0 (deterministic), and assert byte-for-byte parity against expectedConsidered / expectedChosen / expectedReasoning. A drift in either port's scoring math, price table, or energy coefficients breaks both suites. Values were generated from the TS implementation against the committed SSOT tables.
